initial_diagnosis: The orchestration shell was given a 10-second timeout for a complete-episode monitor, and the missing host JSON was initially attributed to detached-process reaping.
corrected_root_cause: A second invocation with a 180-second outer timeout reproduced the same post-shutdown failure and exposed a PowerShell boolean serializer defect; bare false tokens were executed as a command before the host JSON write.
diagnostic_verification: Rerun the identical 8GB smoke under a fresh run id while keeping the orchestration exec cell alive for up to 180 seconds; no code or scientific value changed.
repair_budget_for_initial_diagnosis: 0 / 1; diagnosis superseded without a code repair
